caseNameFull: Williams v. Zbaraz Miller, Acting Director, Department of Public Aid of Illinois v. Zbaraz and United States v. Zbaraz

opinions.text: D. C. N. D. Ill. [Probable jurisdiction postponed, ante, p. 962.] Motion of Alan Ernest to be appointed counsel for children unborn and born alive denied. Motion of Legal Defense Fund for Unborn Children for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae denied.
